PSU

Nothing else needed from you. Monday at 10am ET the team sorts the PSU, the right stand and the Gamma 601, and you get the confirmation and tracking by email at this address.

Before you go, one thing: the DC06 sat half-built since May. What made you pick it back up this weekend?

That makes sense, the heat is the real limit in Texas.

Were the two Gamma 602s from the earlier order running before the move, or is the DC06 the first thing going back on?
Have some 601’s from Amazon
Good to know. What made you go to Amazon for those rather than order them here?
Reliable shipping. The experience with y’all have been a nightmare. And I really thought y’all would have been better.

You're right to be annoyed, Tom. A box that arrived with just a board, a replacement stand that didn't fit, and months of silence is not how this should have gone.

The P., the right stand and the Gamma 601 are with the team for Monday, going to the new address.

And I've made you a code for your next order, HD-••••••, $50 off, yours alone, on orders over $200.
If you look back through my orders. You’ll see it was pretty screwed.

I did look, and yes. On the March order the 601s were swapped out and the rest went out in pieces over months. The quad cooling tower order was cancelled and refunded in June. Then the April one turned up as a bare board. Three orders, three problems.

I've logged all of that on the order so the team sees the whole picture Monday, not just the missing parts.
I know not much hope on the BTC but missing out on possible DOGE.

Yeah, that's the sting, the DC06 is your Scrypt box and it's been sitting idle since May while the Litecoin and Doge merge-mine keeps running.

Once the PSU lands you're hashing again the same day, it's plug and play.

If you want, tell me your power rate and I'll run what the DC06 pulls in at (address hidden) before you plug it in.
I think it’s about $.11
Ran the power-cost calculator · 11¢/kWh

At 11 cents you're in decent shape for Texas, that's below the national average, so the DC06 is worth running once it's alive again.

I'm not going to quote you sats-per-month numbers I can't stand behind for Scrypt today, difficulty and Doge price both move. What I can say is the power draw is the small part at your rate.

Anything else before I let you go?
Thank you for your assistance

You're welcome, Tom, and sorry again it took this long to get sorted.
